create.name: Sheffield Iyengar Yoga Centre
create.bio:
Sheffield Iyengar Yoga Centre opened in June 2005, when its founder, Frances Homewood, took on a neglected former chapel in Walkley, facing Ruskin Park, and turned it into the city's first dedicated Iyengar yoga centre. Frances began practising young with a teacher from the first generation trained by B.K.S. Iyengar, and she has spent months studying at the Iyengar institute in Pune, taught by members of the Iyengar family and by Iyengar himself. The centre marked its twentieth year in 2025. It is an affiliated centre of Iyengar Yoga (UK) and is now run by directors Anna Cowlishaw and Carolyn Usher alongside a team of certified teachers, several of whom trained here with Frances.

Two high-ceilinged halls full of light hold the ropes, blocks and wooden props the method relies on. Classes run from Level 1 through to Level 3 and general classes with basic pranayama, many of them both in the hall and online, and most are booked in blocks of several weeks. Newcomers and returners start with a four-week course on the basic postures and breathing. Each month the centre also hosts workshops, visiting senior teachers from the UK and abroad, a class for teachers and a family yoga club.

courses.title: New Starter/ Returner Course
courses.description: A four-week block of weekly one-hour classes for complete beginners and for people coming back after a long break, taught by certified Iyengar teachers. It covers the fundamental postures and simple breathing, ready for joining the Level 1 classes.

courses.title: Weekly Iyengar classes (block booking)
courses.description: The centre's weekly timetable of Level 1, 2 and 3 and general classes, taught in the front hall and, for many classes, online at the same time. Classes are booked in blocks of several weeks or as drop-ins, and missed classes can be swapped or caught up by recording.

courses.title: Introduction to Pranayama with Emma Rattenbury
courses.description: A workshop at the centre introducing the breathing practices of the Iyengar method, led by a visiting teacher.

courses.title: New Year, Online Workshops with Edgar Stringer
courses.description: Two days of online Iyengar workshops to open the year, bookable as a pair or as single days.
